question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are friends and avid readers who occasionally trade books. At the start of the semester, they each buy one new book: Alice gets Walden, Bob gets Dracula, Claire gets Hamlet, Dave gets Jane Eyre, Eve gets Candide, Fred gets Siddhartha, and Gertrude gets Beloved.
As the semester proceeds, they start trading around the new books. First, Alice and Fred swap books. Then, Fred and Alice swap books. Then, Gertrude and Alice swap books. Then, Dave and Gertrude swap books. Then, Eve and Bob swap books. Then, Bob and Eve swap books. Finally, Fred and Claire swap books. At the end of the semester, Alice has
Options:
(A) Walden
(B) Dracula
(C) Hamlet
(D) Jane Eyre
(E) Candide
(F) Siddhartha
(G) Beloved
solution:
Each row lists the books in holder order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: Walden, Dracula, Hamlet, Jane Eyre, Candide, Siddhartha, Beloved
1. Alice ↔ Fred: Siddhartha, Dracula, Hamlet, Jane Eyre, Candide, Walden, Beloved
2. Fred ↔ Alice: Walden, Dracula, Hamlet, Jane Eyre, Candide, Siddhartha, Beloved
3. Gertrude ↔ Alice: Beloved, Dracula, Hamlet, Jane Eyre, Candide, Siddhartha, Walden
4. Dave ↔ Gertrude: Beloved, Dracula, Hamlet, Walden, Candide, Siddhartha, Jane Eyre
5. Eve ↔ Bob: Beloved, Candide, Hamlet, Walden, Dracula, Siddhartha, Jane Eyre
6. Bob ↔ Eve: Beloved, Dracula, Hamlet, Walden, Candide, Siddhartha, Jane Eyre
7. Fred ↔ Claire: Beloved, Dracula, Siddhartha, Walden, Candide, Hamlet, Jane Eyre
Alice has Beloved, option (G).
Final answer: (G)
